feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: PM to say 'Brexit hasn't worked' and set out conditions for future EU deal in major speech
articles.summary: The prime minister will call for a reset of Britain's relationship with Europe ahead of Friday's UK-EU summit - and assert that "the Brexit we were given has not worked".

articles.title: England hang on to beat world champions Spain 3-2 in Madrid thriller
articles.summary: A 10-man England hung on to beat world champions Spain 3-2 in Madrid to top their Nations League group.

articles.title: Man dies after being struck by ambulance
articles.summary: A man has died after being hit by an ambulance that was taking a patient to hospital near Sunderland, police said.

articles.title: More cold health alerts to take effect after temperatures drop to -6C
articles.summary: Frosty conditions are expected to persist into next week, as more cold health alerts have been issued for parts of the UK on Sunday night until Thursday morning.

articles.title: Man, 21, stabbed to death in London
articles.summary: Police are appealing for witnesses to come forward after a 21-year-old man died following a stabbing in London.

articles.title: Wales beat the All Blacks for first time since 1953
articles.summary: Wales have beaten New Zealand in a men's rugby union match for the first time in 73 years.

articles.title: Former SAS chief blames state for breaking 'moral contract' with soldiers
articles.summary: A former commanding officer of the SAS blamed the state for breaking a "moral contract" between the country and its top soldiers by setting up an inquiry into war crimes which has failed to reach conclusions four years on.

articles.title: Fifteen people taken to hospital after 'wilful' fire in Glasgow
articles.summary: Fifteen people have been taken to hospital after a fire suspected to have been lit deliberately in Glasgow.

articles.title: Business secretary to hold further talks with Poundland owners amid rescue talks
articles.summary: Jonathan Reynolds, the business secretary, is to hold further talks with Poundland's owner and its management team amid a race to save the discount retailer from collapse.

articles.title: Murder investigation launched after 'shocking attack by men in balaclavas'
articles.summary: A 27-year-old man was stabbed to death in a north Manchester suburb in the early hours of Saturday morning.
